🔑 RoomEscape

Explore a room, find hidden objects, and solve puzzles to escape. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Click on objects to examine or collect them.
  2. Some items can be combined to create new tools.
  3. Solve puzzles using the items and clues you've found.
  4. Explore every part of the room — hidden compartments contain clues.
  5. Follow the puzzle chain to find the key and escape.
